steel_strength.csv.description: CSV derived from the public steel_strength source with all original rows and values retained. Only the derived CSV is included in this Data folder.
steel_strength.csv.verification: 01 checks the SHA-256 of this exact CSV before reading it.

LiFePO4.cif.description: Crystallographic CIF fixture from a pinned public pymatgen commit; included as a reproducible structure-format example

Li-Fe-P-O_entries.json.description: Historical MP-derived computed-entry fixture from a pinned public pymatgen commit; not a current MP database snapshot

steel_strength.json.gz.description: Original compressed matminer snapshot of the experimental Citrine steel-strength dataset; bytes preserved

ucsb_thermoelectrics.json.gz.description: Original compressed matminer snapshot of the experimental UCSB/Citrine thermoelectrics compilation; bytes preserved

matbench_expt_gap.json.gz.description: Original compressed Matbench snapshot of composition-deduplicated experimental band gaps from Zhuo et al.; bytes preserved

citrine_thermal_conductivity.json.gz.description: Original compressed matminer snapshot of experimental thermal-conductivity records collected from Citrine; bytes preserved
